## 🚀 Feature Summary
A clear and concise description of what feature you are proposing.

## 💡 Motivation / Problem Statement
Is your feature request related to a problem or limitation? Please describe. (e.g. *I'm always frustrated when...*)

## 🛠️ Proposed Solution
Describe the solution you would like, including any UI changes, architectural modifications, or model enhancements.

## 🔄 Alternatives Considered
A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

## 📌 Additional Context
Add any other context, mockup designs, or relevant research links here.
